# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4948

# Review — PAN-4948
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — PR #4966 description omits the required operator-redeploy sentence (docs-connector-clients.ac4 / NFR-3)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4948-review-01050a50
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4948/.pan/review/agent-pan-4948-review-01050a50/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4948 · /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4948
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4966 (headRefOid 01050a50ffffeb1a3b397ffe9a56d690f3584c74)
- HEAD reviewed: 01050a50ffffeb1a3b397ffe9a56d690f3584c74
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base e8789fce9b0 (origin/main); no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] PR description lacks the connect.overdeck.ai redeploy statement — PR #4966 body
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap against an explicit acceptance criterion; in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: The plan item `docs-connector-clients` carries AC `docs-connector-clients.ac4`: "The PR description contains the sentence that connect.overdeck.ai must be redeployed by the operator before W-CONN2 ships" (`.pan/specs/2026-11-03-PAN-4948-…xbrief.json`, line 466). NFR-3 in `.pan/drafts/pan-4948.md` and the PRD's AC-7 say the same. The spec's own decision note (line 74) explains why: "The CP-5 directory deploy is not a plan item; the PR description must state the operator redeploy requirement."
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected a sentence in the PR body. Observed: `gh pr view 4966 --json body` shows only the issue link and six checked plan-item titles; no deploy statement. The operator who merges this PR does not see that connect.overdeck.ai must be redeployed before any `@overdeck/core` release ships the connector. An older directory refuses `hello-client` with `platform: node` as `bad_frame`, so a connector released before the redeploy cannot register.
- Evidence: `gh pr view 4966 --json body -q .body` (full body read). The docs half of the requirement is met: `docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md` "Deploy" now carries the CP-5 note. The PR-description half is not.
- Fix: Edit the PR #4966 description to add, for example: "Operator step: connect.overdeck.ai must be redeployed (docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md "Deploy") before W-CONN2 (`pan mcp connector`) ships in any `@overdeck/core` release (PAN-4927 CP-5). No agent deploys it." Apply it with `gh pr edit 4966 --body-file <file>` (keep the existing body). No code change is needed.

## Non-blocking Findings

- `~` **Stray verified-timestamp comment in `.overdeck/context/codebase/concerns.md` (line 656).** The diff adds `<!-- last-verified: 2026-11-03 -->` between two bullets of an unrelated list, next to the existing `<!-- last-verified: 2026-11-03 (PAN-4905, PAN-4917, PAN-4925) -->` at line 665. It is this branch's net effect against main, from the branch commit 0fffefd6810 ("dedupe stale verified-timestamp comment") after a main merge, and is outside PAN-4948's scope. It is harmless HTML-comment noise; drop the line at 656 if the PR is touched again.
- `?` **Push to a connector.** A machine `push` addressed to a `node` client finds `push: null` on the row and fails the normal way. That matches the design (connectors never hold push), and no code path lets a `node` row gain push: the decoder refuses `push-register` with `platform: node`, and `push-state.ts:55` refuses an `ios`/`android` register from a `node` row as a platform mismatch. So the doc claim "push-register from a node client is always bad_frame" holds. No action.
- Environment note (not a code defect): `npm run typecheck:mobile` fails here only with `TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'vite/client'` because `apps/mobile/node_modules/vite` is a broken symlink in this workspace install (`file` reports "broken symbolic link"). No other mobile diagnostic appears. The PR does not change mobile code; `ClientPlatform` only widens, and `shellPlatform()` still returns `ios`/`android`. CI `build (22)` and the lint groups cover the mobile lane on the PR head.

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** Traced decoder → `reduceClient` → `helloClient` → `put-client` effect → `loadDirectory` rehydration → push path (`push-state.ts`, `deliver.ts`). Phone behavior unchanged: the phone cap now counts phones only, which can only admit phones that were previously blocked by connectors (none existed before this change). Re-hello in the same family above the cap is still allowed (`kept`). A refused family change returns `planned` state and leaves the old row. The web client's close handler overrides the `error`-frame message deterministically (D-4). No defects found.
- **Security:** No new trust boundary. Connectors authenticate with the same bearer device token. Per-account rows are bounded (5 + 10). `node` rows cannot acquire a push registration by type or at runtime. No findings.
- **Performance:** `filter` over at most 15 client rows per hello. No findings.
- **Requirements/UX:** See matrix; one unmet AC (blocking above).
